text.title: Who may do what
text.intro: Every endpoint lists the roles it accepts and the router asks one guard before running it.
text.role customer: anyone whose e-mail is on no staff list
text.role clerk: shop staff who pack and ship orders
text.role manager: the owner, who can also cancel orders
text.cell customer pay-order: the order id is not compared with the caller's e-mail, so any signed-in customer can pay any order
text.source email-lists: two hard-coded e-mail lists give clerk and manager; everyone else is a customer
text.guard require-role: true when the caller's role is in the endpoint's list; the router calls it before the service
